description: Na₂LiMn(PO₃)₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one MnO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.66 Å. Li is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.99 Å) and two longer (2.24 Å) Li-O bond lengths. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are four shorter (2.15 Å) and two longer (2.21 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, and corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-56°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.65 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MnO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.64 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids and corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.64 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent P atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Li and two P atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Mn and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms.
